title.orig: An Act Declaring the Seventh (7th) Day of January of Every Year as a Special Working Public Holiday for the Province of Camiguin, to Be Known as "Araw Ng Camiguin"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2001/ra_9094_2001.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: January seven of every year is hereby declared as a special working public holiday in the Province of Camiguin to commemorate its charter day anniversary.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.

titleTranslation.note: 由翻译 agent 按《法规标题中译规范》产出，经 tools/verify-title-return.js 机器校验后入库；尚未人工复核。
